message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer and for your clear wish to build a long-term partnership. We value that, and we would like to find a workable basis together.

Our data shows a different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

With that in mind, here are options for you to consider. Reliable, punctual payment and steady call-offs matter to us as part of a stable partnership, and we are glad to discuss how the options support that.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

Please let us know which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. You mentioned punctual payment, which is great because late payments really hurt us right now, so we expect you to pay on time going forward. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.

Our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint. I can offer a compromise of 1500 ppm and a 150 EUR chargeback, but we need 46.00 EUR per unit to make this work, so we also have an alternative with a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.
